projects.name: AI Resume Matcher

Compared resume information with job requirements to find relevant candidates based on their skills.

projects.name: Draw.Together
bullets: Built a web application combining text editing and diagram creation in one workspace.
Added an interactive whiteboard with drawing tools and implemented secure JWT-based authentication.
Implemented real-time collaboration canvas with responsive Tailwind CSS interface.

projects.name: Online Book Store Application
bullets: Developed a full-stack online bookstore application using React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented secure JWT-based user authentication with Sign Up and Login and connected frontend with backend APIs using Axios.
Built features for browsing, and managing books with real-time data updates.
Designed a responsive and modern user interface using Tailwind CSS for seamless experience across devices.
Integrated shopping cart functionality and connected frontend with backend APIs.

projects.name: Movie Recommender App
bullets: Developed a content-based Movie Recommender System using Python and Streamlit to suggest movies based on similarity scores.
Implemented cosine similarity with movie metadata and tags to generate personalized movie recommendations.
Integrated the TMDB API to display movie posters, ratings, and detailed movie information dynamically.
Added advanced filtering options including genre, release year, and rating for improved user experience.
Optimized application performance using caching techniques and designed a fully responsive UI with dark/light theme toggle.
